The claim that AI is going to kill all humans is bullshit but AI execs genuinely believe the claim, which is evidence that they have all had their brains melted and their critical faculties gutted in which case we need to stop privileging their horseshit in credulous news stories which transcribe their every word or, better yet, stop listening to them entirely; or
The claim that AI is going to kill all humans is true, in which case these products should be immediately shut down, the companies behind them should be investigated and broken up, and scores if not hundreds of the people behind it all should be prosecuted and imprisoned, with whoever else is left sued into oblivion.
Has to be one of those things. Which is it?
